text: Hello Mrs. Alvarez, this is Officer Daniel Brooks with the public defender's office. Your grandson was involved in a traffic incident and is being held. There is a gag order on this case so please do not discuss it with other family members. Bond is $8,500. A courier will come to your home this afternoon to collect it in cash. Please reply to confirm you are home.
notes: Professionally written 'lawyer/officer' variant. Gag-order secrecy and courier cash pickup are major indicators. Role confusion (officer vs public defender).
